description: Submit a domain that publishes an llms.txt so it gets crawled and indexed. Returns the verification instructions so you can continue without another call. Verified owners get: Verified ownership displayed; verified-first browsing and relevance-first search; "verified": true in API responses, and included in verified=true queries; +15 authority, and the featured tier (do-follow links) from 60 instead of 70; Listed with a link in https://agentwebmap.com/llms.txt, the file agents read; An embeddable "verified" badge (SVG) that links back here; Breakage alerts by webhook or email when the llms.txt stops validating or the proof disappears; Your terms for agents (automated access, rate limit, attribution, pricing) published where agents read them; Editable profile: description, tags, nested llms.txt files, contact; Lookup analytics and score history (GET /v1/sites/:domain/stats); Instant re-crawl on demand.
